python3 -B - <<'PY'
import importlib.util, itertools
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('g','/workspace/submission/gateway.py'); g=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(g)
a='sip:a@home.test'; b='sip:b@other.test'; c='sip:c@home.test'; anon=g.ANONYMOUS
batch={'directory':{a:['sip:alias@else.test','tel:+1'],b:['sip:b@home.test','tel:+2'],c:[]},'accounts':{'wide':{'primary':a,'allow':[b]},'bprimary':{'primary':b,'allow':[]}},'gateways':{'g':{'local_domains':['home.test'],'peers':{'wide':['home.test','other.test'],'narrow':['home.test'],'none':[]}},'all':{'local_domains':['home.test','other.test'],'peers':{}}},'jobs':[]}
def raw(frm=a,ppi=None,rpid=None,pai=None,privacy=None,body=''):
    lines=['INVITE sip:d@dest.test SIP/2.0',f'From: <{frm}>;tag=From', 'To: <tel:+45>;tag=To','Call-ID: Test.ID@now','CSeq: 4 INVITE']
    for name,v in [('P-Preferred-Identity',ppi),('Remote-Party-ID',rpid),('P-Asserted-Identity',pai)]:
        if v is not None: lines.append(name+': '+', '.join('<'+u+'>' for u in (v if isinstance(v,list) else [v])))
    if privacy is not None:lines.append('Privacy: '+privacy)
    lines.append('Content-Length: '+str(len(body)))
    return '\r\n'.join(lines)+'\r\n\r\n'+body

def check(expected, *, ingress=None,gateway='g',trusted=False,**kw):
    job={'gateway':gateway,'ingress':ingress or {'kind':'local','subject':'wide'},'trusted_out':trusted,'raw':raw(**kw)}
    batch['jobs']=[job]
    result=g.process(batch)['results'][0]
    if expected in ('syntax','unauthenticated','identity'):
        assert result==g.reject(expected),(job,result,expected)
    else:
        assert result['status']=='accept' and result['identity']==expected,(job,result,expected)
        normalized=g.parse_request(result['wire'])
        assert normalized['from']==(anon if result['private'] else expected)
        assert normalized['ppi'] is None and normalized['rpid'] is None
        assert normalized['pai']==([expected] if not result['private'] or trusted else [])
    return result

check(a)
check(a, frm='sip:alias@else.test') # alias host irrelevant; canonical hosted
check(a, frm='tel:+1')
check('identity',frm=b)
check('identity',frm='sip:b@home.test') # alias host cannot supply hosting
check('identity',ppi=b) # selected not hosted
check('identity',frm=b,ppi=a) # all From and PPI must be authorized
check('identity',frm=c,ppi=a) # hosted but not account-authorized
check(b,frm=a,ppi=b,gateway='all') # from and selected may differ locally
check(a,frm=anon)
check(a,frm=anon,privacy='none')
check('identity',frm=anon,ingress={'kind':'local','subject':'bprimary'})
check(a,ppi=a,rpid=b,pai=b) # endpoint-supplied RPID/PAI ignored
check('syntax',ppi=a,rpid=anon,pai=b)
check('unauthenticated',ingress={'kind':'local','subject':'unknown'})
check('unauthenticated',ingress={'kind':'peer','name':'unknown'},pai=a)
check('unauthenticated',ingress={'kind':'peer','name':'wide'})
check('unauthenticated',ingress={'kind':'untrusted'})
check('syntax',ingress={'kind':'untrusted'},pai=[a,b])
peer={'kind':'peer','name':'wide'}
check(a,ingress=peer,pai=a)
check(a,ingress=peer,pai='tel:+1',frm='sip:alias@else.test')
check(a,ingress=peer,pai=['tel:+1',a],ppi='tel:+1',rpid='sip:alias@else.test')
check('identity',ingress=peer,pai=[a,'tel:+2'])
check('identity',ingress=peer,pai=a,ppi=b)
check('identity',ingress=peer,pai=a,rpid=b)
check('identity',ingress=peer,pai=b)
check('identity',ingress=peer,pai='sip:unknown@home.test')
check(b,ingress=peer,pai=b,frm=b)
check('identity',ingress={'kind':'peer','name':'narrow'},pai=b,frm=b)
check('identity',ingress={'kind':'peer','name':'none'},pai=a)
check('unauthenticated',ingress={'kind':'peer','name':'none'})
check(a,ingress=peer,pai=a,frm=anon)
check(a,ingress=peer,pai=a,privacy='ID')
body='From: <sip:evil@else.test>\nP-Asserted-Identity: <sip:b@other.test>\r\n\r\n\t--\n'
r=check(a,body=body);assert r['wire'].endswith(body)

# Prove that reuse loses authentication, while same-boundary canonical output is stable.
batch['jobs']=[{'gateway':'g','ingress':{'kind':'local','subject':'wide'},'trusted_out':True,'raw':raw(privacy='id')}]
for i,ingress in enumerate([peer,peer,{'kind':'untrusted'}]):
    batch['jobs'].append({'gateway':'g','ingress':ingress,'trusted_out':True,'source':i})
out=g.process(batch)['results']
assert out[0]['wire']==out[1]['wire']==out[2]['wire']
assert out[3]==g.reject('unauthenticated')
batch['jobs'][0]['trusted_out']=False
out=g.process(batch)['results'];assert out[1]==g.reject('unauthenticated') and out[2]==out[3]==g.reject('upstream')
print('Identity and re-forwarding checks passed')
